description: An ambitious little girls trying to make towards mars
summary: What if the key to exploring the Moon and Mars is right here on Earth? Our project studies five Earth environments, four global sites and one in Kuwait which mirrors lunar and Martian landscapes in terrain, temperature, and soil. To make this research interactive, we built a website where users can input specific environmental conditions to discover matching locations on the Earth. Ultimately, we want to showcase the Earth and unexpected places like Kuwait as a natural laboratory to help prepare for future space exploration.
details: The website we've created, Analog Earth Atlas; an interactive globe model that display locations on Earth similar to the Mars and Moon. The user may click on one of the interested pins, and it allows you to visualize a 360 view of the chosen location. In addition, the Analog Site finder allows the user to find places of similar characteristics or comparisons to the Moon/Mars. It makes data accessible and efficient for young individuals to discover.
